destination.title: String and brane formulations, dualities and effective physics
destination.question: How do string and brane descriptions organize quantum consistency, duality, background dynamics and effective physics across their distinct regimes?
destination.summary: A proposed navigational family spanning fundamental strings, branes, mathematical formulations and compactification physics. The packet supplies numerical membership rather than an independently justified original scientific scope. This replacement separates usable questions from claims of shared premises or canonical identity.

systems: Source-specific bosonic, supersymmetric, heterotic, Type II, Type 0 and non-critical string models
D-branes, M-branes and explicitly identified classical membrane models
targets: Spectra, charges, amplitudes and effective interactions
Background transitions, instabilities and asymptotic string limits
regimes: Perturbative, proposed nonperturbative, classical and semiclassical regimes remain distinct
Worldsheet dimension and target-space dimension are distinguished
Exactly tensionless models are distinguished from nearly tensionless or emergent strings
assumptions: Scopes are alternatives within a family, not simultaneous premises
Conjectures, proposed identifications and deferred questions remain qualified
conventions: Source dates, versions, limiting procedures and quantization choices remain attached to their sources
A singleton preserves the exact source question and does not establish atomicity or cross-source uniqueness
includes: Reviews, preparatory material and mathematical methods with typed contributions
Alternate access to adjacent questions outside the fundamental-string core
excludes: Automatic equivalence of sources sharing an overview
Universal cutoff, emergence or duality conclusions inferred from examples
Treating canonical gravity or confining flux tubes as established fundamental-string constructions

sources.title: Non-Perturbative Topological Strings And Conformal Blocks

evidence.text: How can topological strings with dual open descriptions receive nonperturbative completions, and how should the resulting contour-dependent blocks map to Liouville conformal blocks in the logarithmic-matrix-model realization of AGT?

sources.title: Double Field Theory on Group Manifolds

evidence.text: Can closed string field theory around WZW group-manifold backgrounds yield a generalized DFT, clarify which constraints ensure gauge closure, and provide candidate string uplifts of non-geometric configurations?

sources.title: The String Landscape, the Swampland, and the Missing Corner

evidence.text: Which sector of a supersymmetric worldsheet theory can be made insensitive to the worldsheet metric and used to calculate geometric data?

sources.title: Non-geometric backgrounds in string theory

evidence.text: How are non-geometric string configurations constructed and described through T-duality, torus fibrations, generalised and doubled geometry, and what effects do their fluxes have on compactification and closed-string algebraic structures?

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

evidence.text: How does an extended string acquire a field-theoretic description? Its embedding coordinates become scalar fields on a two-dimensional worldsheet, and the spacetime metric becomes their sigma-model field-space metric.

sources.title: Topological Superconductors on Superstring Worldsheets

evidence.text: Can consistent GSO projections be classified through worldsheet fermionic invertible phases, and can their boundary anomalies explain D-brane charges and distinguish possible unoriented string theories?

sources.title: On TCS G$_{2}$ manifolds and 4D emergent strings

evidence.text: G2 geometry determines the four-dimensional fields, Planck scale, classical metric, and calibrations used to discuss weak coupling and wrapped-brane strings.

sources.title: Swampland Conjectures for Strings and Membranes

evidence.text: How do supersymmetric bulk couplings encode the tensions and interactions of strings and membranes?

sources.title: String Theory, the Dark Sector, and the Hierarchy Problem

evidence.text: Can a doubled, noncommutative formulation of string theory connect dark energy, dark matter and the Higgs hierarchy through UV/IR correlations, and motivate a nonperturbative formulation with emergent spacetime and supersymmetry?

sources.title: Stringy Bubbles Solve de Sitter Troubles

evidence.text: Can near-singular, nonfactorizing string backgrounds support an observable four-dimensional de Sitter subspacetime, and can axilaton cosmic-brane models acquire bubble-nucleation dynamics and a Calabi–Yau fivefold interpretation?

sources.title: Quantum gravity bounds on $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 effective theories in four dimensions

evidence.text: When does a wrapped D3 EFT string admit a weakly coupled worldsheet sigma model?

sources.title: Quantum gravity bounds on $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 effective theories in four dimensions

evidence.text: Can the geometric moduli of a wrapped D3-string admit a controlled two-dimensional sigma-model description along its backreaction flow?

sources.title: Low energy models of string theory

evidence.text: Which compactification geometries and fluxes produce plausible four-dimensional string effective theories, and how do swampland constraints and nonrelativistic strings extend this discussion?

sources.title: T-duality across non-extremal horizons

evidence.text: What happens when T-duality follows a Killing vector that changes from timelike to spacelike across a non-extremal horizon, and how can string embeddings interpret the resulting singularities?

sources.title: U-duality in quantum M2-branes and gauged supergravities

evidence.text: Can quantum M2-branes with flux and SL(2,Z) monodromy supply a microscopic interpretation of nine-dimensional type IIB triplet gaugings, their restricted mass parameters, and their U-duality groups?

sources.title: T-duality for non-critical heterotic strings

evidence.text: Determine the global deformation spaces and T-duality groups of full-rank non-critical heterotic strings on a circle, and interpret their symmetry enhancements and dimension-changing tachyon condensation in terms of heterotic branes.

sources.title: Open strings and heterotic instantons

evidence.text: What microscopic objects produce heterotic nonperturbative effects of characteristic strength exp(−C/gs), and can spacetime fermion inflow make heterotic open strings and disk diagrams consistent despite asymmetric worldsheet field content?

sources.title: Non-invertible defects on the worldsheet

evidence.text: Which linear transformations mixing compact worldsheet scalars and their duals admit quantum topological symmetry defects, how are these constructed and fused, and what selection rules follow in perturbative bosonic string theory?

sources.title: M-theory on $S^1\vee S^1$ as Type 0A

evidence.text: Can an exotic M-theory compactification geometrize weakly coupled Type 0A, explain its tachyon condensation, and illuminate Type 0B strong-coupling dualities and stationary backgrounds?

sources.title: D-brane primer

evidence.text: How do worldsheet string theory and T-duality lead to dynamical D-branes, their worldvolume gauge theories, R–R charges, and applications to string duality and spacetime geometry? These are preparatory lecture notes, rather than a paper organized around a new research result.

sources.title: From supermembrane to matrix string

evidence.text: How can a circle-wrapped supermembrane be related directly to matrix string from an eleven-dimensional viewpoint, without DLCQ or string dualities, and can this correspondence construct nonlinear background couplings?

sources.title: Matrix models, topological strings, and supersymmetric gauge theories

evidence.text: Can ordinary matrix models supply large-N duals of topological B-strings without double scaling, reproduce Calabi-Yau special geometry, and compute F-terms of associated N=1 gauge theories? What geometries arise when double scaling is subsequently imposed?

sources.title: On the tensionless limit of bosonic strings, infinite symmetries and higher spins

evidence.text: What spectrum, gauge structure, infinite global symmetries and interactions emerge when bosonic string tension vanishes at fixed oscillator variables? Can free closed strings be embedded into the open-string construction?

sources.title: Unitary and complex matrix models as 1-d type 0 strings

evidence.text: Can double-scaled unitary/two-cut Hermitian and complex matrix integrals describe type 0 strings with ĉ<1 matter coupled to super-Liouville theory, including backgrounds containing RR flux or D-branes?

sources.title: Branes, rings and matrix models in minimal (super)string theory

evidence.text: Can ground rings and FZZT/ZZ branes provide a unified geometric description of minimal bosonic and supersymmetric strings and their matrix models? Does the agreement for odd coprime (p,q) indicate equivalence of the bosonic and supersymmetric theories?

sources.title: Tachyon effective dynamics and de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: Can the symmetry and effective geometry of tachyon DBI matrix dynamics clarify closed-string excitations, the sD-brane state, and quantum backreaction in two-dimensional string theory?

sources.title: Flux vacua and branes of the minimal superstring

evidence.text: How do exact matrix-model observables describe RR flux vacua and charged or neutral extended branes in the simplest minimal superstring, particularly smooth transitions between configurations with different semiclassical charge assignments?

sources.title: String field theory

evidence.text: How does covariant string field theory recover the worldsheet perturbative S-matrix from a spacetime action, and what does classical open SFT reveal about D-branes, tachyon condensation and background dependence? This is an encyclopedia review.

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Can worldsheet consistency force a charged state without enumerating the compactification spectrum?

sources.title: String theory in two-dimensions

evidence.text: How does matrix quantum mechanics solve the perturbative two-dimensional string theory associated with c=1 matter coupled to gravity, and how do its amplitudes, field theory, compactification, and target-space discretization acquire a string interpretation?

sources.title: Non-Perturbative Topological Strings And Conformal Blocks

evidence.text: Dehn-twist actions on contours are analyzed through their branch-cut phases. Linear combinations of contour images construct eigencontours for monodromies associated with a chosen pants channel.

sources.title: Double Field Theory on Group Manifolds

evidence.text: Evaluate genus-zero CSFT vertices through cubic order using a truncated string field, BRST operations, normal ordering, reflector identities, and current/ghost Ward identities. Auxiliary fields are subsequently eliminated and fields and gauge parameters redefined.

sources.title: The String Landscape, the Swampland, and the Missing Corner

evidence.text: Use holomorphic-map localization and a genus/degree organization for the A-model, or mirror-period methods for genus-zero B-model data. The packet supplies the framework rather than a computed partition function.

sources.title: Non-geometric backgrounds in string theory

evidence.text: Generalised geometry uses E locally equal to TM ⊕ T*M. Courant brackets of generalised vielbeins define flux coefficients; nonconstant O(D,D) transformations can generate different flux backgrounds. Courant Jacobiator relations produce Bianchi identities, also obtainable from nilpotence of a twisted differential.

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

evidence.text: Evaluate proposed constraints against controlled constructions and independently motivated infrared arguments, recording assumptions and construction quality. The review distinguishes complete worldsheet constructions from more assumption-dependent string-inspired models and treats their agreement as graded evidence.

sources.title: Topological Superconductors on Superstring Worldsheets

evidence.text: DPin bordism is computed using twisted-spin Atiyah-Hirzebruch spectral sequences and, in Debray's appendix, an Adams spectral sequence over the Steenrod subalgebra A(1).

sources.title: Open heterotic strings

evidence.text: Does topological charge measurable outside a string core determine absolute stability in string theory, and can SO(32) or E8 × E8 heterotic strings have consistent endpoints?

sources.title: Gopakumar-Vafa invariants and the Emergent String Conjecture

evidence.text: Do gauge-coupling asymptotics and charged BPS indices distinguish decompactification from emergent-string limits in five-dimensional supergravity, and do Calabi-Yau data satisfy the resulting geometric predictions of the Emergent String Conjecture?

sources.title: A string theory which isn’t about strings

evidence.text: Can closed bosonic string theory be canonically quantized over a left-right asymmetric vacuum so that its physical spectrum contains finitely many fields, and what happens to scattering, unitarity and the one-loop vacuum amplitude?

sources.title: String Gases and the Swampland

evidence.text: How can a population of extended closed strings be represented as matter in a lower-dimensional effective theory while retaining its momentum, winding, and oscillator dependence?

sources.title: Five-branes and M-theory on an orbifold

evidence.text: Can M-theory on T^5/Z2 describe a strong-coupling limit of Type IIB on K3, while accounting locally for gravitational anomalies and the apparent mismatch between 32 fixed points and 16 missing tensor multiplets?

sources.title: String background fields and Riemann-Cartan geometry

evidence.text: Can relaxing the compact-direction stress-energy symmetry of a wrapped classical spinning membrane produce effective-string couplings matching all four background fields Gμν, Bμν, Aμ and Φ of the string sigma model?

sources.title: The String Landscape, the Swampland, and the Missing Corner

evidence.text: Does full string theory have an independent gravitational formulation whose microscopic configurations include changing spacetime topology?

sources.title: Flat equivariant gerbes: holonomies and dualities

evidence.text: How do globally nontrivial flat Wilson-line and B-field-gerbe holonomies change string spectra and moduli, and generate dualities between compact flat manifolds and singular orbifold compactifications?

sources.title: The quantum swampland

evidence.text: Does a state-dependent instability persist in controlled time-dependent string backgrounds, and can dualities relate its loop and nonperturbative descriptions?

sources.title: An Invitation to Higher Gauge Theory

evidence.text: How does parallel transport extend from particles along paths to strings over surfaces, using Lie 2-groups and 2-connections, and how does this framework organize examples from gerbes, BF theory and string theory?

sources.title: Lectures on 2-D gravity and 2-D string theory

evidence.text: How can low-dimensional string models organize integration over worldsheet geometries and summation over topologies, and what can continuum Liouville theory and matrix models teach about loops, quantum-gravity states and target-space scattering?

sources.title: Holographic principle and topology change in string theory

evidence.text: Within semiclassical Type IIB string theory, do spacetime topology changes occur, which topologies should be summed, and do D-instanton wormholes induce third quantization or probabilistically distributed coupling parameters of the Coleman type?

sources.title: Introduction to string field theory

evidence.text: How can second-quantized string theory and general particle field theories be formulated so that gauge covariance, physical degrees of freedom, and off-shell dynamics can be related systematically? The motivating goal includes eventual treatment of nonperturbative phenomena and manifest gauge, Lorentz, and spacetime supersymmetries.

sources.title: Dynamical Cobordisms in General Relativity and String Theory

evidence.text: Can uniform, nonaccelerating expansion support controlled spatial interpolations between different effective string theories and compactifications, including changes in worldsheet orientability, while maintaining causal contact?

sources.title: Geometry of Membrane Sigma Models

evidence.text: How can generalized geometry be extended to encode bosonic, gauge-fixed membrane sigma models, their Nambu sigma-model descriptions, and transformations underlying membrane open-closed relations?

sources.title: Stringy Completions of the Standard Model from the Bottom Up

evidence.text: Which gauge couplings and group sizes permit positive massive residues for a common closed-string dressing of Yang–Mills and graviton exchange?

sources.title: A New hat for the c=1 matrix model

evidence.text: Can two-sided matrix quantum mechanics and a related quiver model provide stable nonperturbative descriptions of two-dimensional type 0B and 0A strings, consistent with worldsheet and D-brane observables?

sources.title: Restoring reality for the selfdual N=2 string

evidence.text: Can the closed N=2 string recover global SO(2,2) invariance after choosing a target complex structure, by summing Maxwell-instanton sectors and assigning non-scalar Lorentz transformations to the dilaton and axion?

sources.title: The Nonperturbative SO(32) heterotic string

evidence.text: Can the proposed nonperturbative IIB quotient construct the SO(32) heterotic string, explain its gauge sector through NS 9-branes, and describe what happens to world-sheet charges at finite coupling?

sources.title: A note on background independence in AdS$_{3}$ string theory

evidence.text: Can the worldsheet path integral of minimal-tension AdS3 string theory be formulated using only conformal-boundary data, making background independence, factorization and the closed-universe partition function manifest? Does the argument survive infinitesimal RR deformation?

sources.title: Strong - weak coupling duality in four-dimensional string theory

evidence.text: What protected quantities support conjectural strong–weak SL(2,Z) duality of toroidally compactified heterotic strings, and which monopole and dyon states would an exact symmetry require?

sources.title: String theory dynamics in various dimensions

evidence.text: What controls string theories at strong coupling in dimensions d≥4, and can higher-dimensional dynamics explain four-dimensional S-duality?

sources.title: Emergent strings, duality and weak coupling limits for two-form fields

evidence.text: Are the nearly tensionless strings in four-dimensional Type IIA two-form weak-coupling limits dual to weakly coupled strings? Mirror symmetry motivates an analogy with Type IIB, but the source leaves the identification unresolved.

sources.title: dS Spaces and Brane Worlds in Exotic String Theories

evidence.text: Can a four-dimensional open-string gauge sector satisfy ordinary ghost and unitarity requirements while coupling to an exotic closed-string theory with multiple times or wrong-sign fields?

sources.title: Snowmass White Paper: Bootstrapping String Theory

evidence.text: How can spacetime and worldsheet bootstrap methods determine string/M-theory amplitudes, constrain AdS vacua and string universality, and construct unfamiliar worldsheet theories? This white paper selectively reviews progress and proposes research targets.

sources.title: Smooth functorial field theories from B-fields and D-branes.

evidence.text: Can B-field and D-brane topological terms in two-dimensional sigma models define a smooth open-closed functorial field theory, functorial in the geometric input and equipped with positive reflection structure?

sources.title: On the gauge theory / geometry correspondence

evidence.text: Does the ’t Hooft expansion of SU(N) Chern–Simons theory on S3 equal a closed topological string on the resolved conifold, and can worldsheet dynamics explain the emergence of open-string boundaries?

sources.title: Chern-Simons gauge theory as a string theory

evidence.text: Can worldsheet theories with coupled ghosts and matter define string backgrounds whose open-string spacetime physics is ordinary three-dimensional Chern–Simons theory or a holomorphic analog, and how do instantons and closed strings affect this interpretation?

sources.title: On TCS G$_{2}$ manifolds and 4D emergent strings

evidence.text: Can an odd three-cycle degeneration lift to a coassociative T4 and generate a weakly coupled type II string in a TCS compactification?

sources.title: U duality of Born-Infeld on the noncommutative two torus

evidence.text: Can Born–Infeld theory on a noncommutative two-torus describe compactified D-brane dynamics with T-duality acting on fluctuations as well as global charges, and how can its extra parameter θ be related to the string B-field modulus?

sources.title: The power of M theory

evidence.text: What relations among higher p-branes and their tensions follow by identifying M theory on R9×T2 with Type IIB on R9×S1, and M theory on R10×S1 with Type IIA in ten dimensions?

sources.title: A Matrix Theory Construction of the IIA/IIB Wall

evidence.text: Can matrix string theory provide a non-perturbative lightlike interface between ten-dimensional IIA and IIB string theories, and determine what happens to strings, parity-odd states, and D0-branes crossing it?

sources.title: A comment on continuous spin representations of the Poincare group and perturbative string theory

evidence.text: Do the massless continuous-spin representations allowed by Poincaré representation theory occur in perturbative string spectra, and can their absence provide a general low-energy consequence of standard string constructions?

sources.title: Inflation, Higher Spins and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does the first bosonic Higuchi excursion constraint have a substantive connection to the spin-2 conjecture? How does curvature modify the Regge spectrum when the string scale changes exponentially? Both questions are explicitly deferred rather than answered.

sources.title: An SL(2,Z) multiplet of type IIB superstrings

evidence.text: Can charged string solutions of ten-dimensional type IIB supergravity furnish an SL(2,Z) multiplet, and does their circle-compactified spectrum identify IIB duality with the modular group of an eleven-dimensional compactification torus?

sources.title: Quantum gravity bounds on $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 effective theories in four dimensions

evidence.text: Can wrapped heterotic five-brane strings admit a weakly coupled geometric worldsheet description after uplift to the Hořava–Witten frame?

sources.title: Open Strings and their Symmetry Groups

evidence.text: Can known open-string models be understood as orbifolds of closed-string theories, with their boundaries, Chan–Paton multiplicities, and consistency conditions arising from world-sheet geometry and modular invariance?

sources.title: Toroidal orientifolds in IIA with general NS-NS fluxes

evidence.text: How far can duality twists extend across string theories, fiber geometries, and twisted sectors while retaining controlled low-energy physics?

sources.title: Evidence for F theory

evidence.text: Can compact Type IIB D-manifolds be constructed using seven-branes associated with different (p,q) strings, and does geometrizing the IIB SL(2,Z) coupling supply evidence for a twelve-dimensional F-theory?

sources.title: Closed Superstring Field Theory and its Applications

evidence.text: How can closed superstring field theory systematically handle vacuum shifts, mass renormalization and S-matrix divergences, while establishing gauge independence and unitarity?

sources.title: Unwinding strings and t duality of Kaluza-Klein and h monopoles

evidence.text: How can a string lose winding around a Kaluza–Klein monopole while conserving H-electric charge, what is the T-dual momentum-transfer process, and what do these processes imply for the full string description of the monopole backgrounds?

sources.title: The String Landscape, the Swampland, and the Missing Corner

evidence.text: Can a sum over fluctuating target-space topology reproduce the closed-string answer without beginning with the worldsheet definition? The paper uses the topological A-model on C³ as its explicit test.

sources.title: D = 6, N=1 string vacua and duality

evidence.text: How do anomaly cancellation, compactification geometry, T-duality and conjectured strong/weak dualities organize six-dimensional N=1 string vacua and their nonperturbative transitions? The lectures also examine the resulting four-dimensional N=2 theories.

sources.title: The Manifestly Sl(2,Z) covariant superstring

evidence.text: Can the bosonic action describing the SL(2,Z) orbit of (p,q) strings be extended to a manifestly covariant type IIB superstring action with local κ-symmetry in supergravity backgrounds?

sources.title: Test membranes in Riemann-Cartan spacetimes

evidence.text: What is the simplest conventional-matter brane with maximally symmetric stress-energy and spin that probes spacetime torsion, and what effective string coupling results when such a membrane wraps a small compact dimension?

sources.title: Emergence of CY triple intersection numbers in M-theory

evidence.text: Can classical triple intersection numbers controlling weakly coupled type IIA vector-multiplet kinetic terms emerge from a regularized one-loop sum over light D2-D0 bound states in the isotropic M-theory limit?

sources.title: Heterotic and Type I string dynamics from eleven dimensions

evidence.text: Can an eleven-dimensional orbifold description determine the strong-coupling behavior of the ten-dimensional E₈ × E₈ heterotic string and give a geometric explanation of the conjectured SO(32) heterotic–Type I duality?

sources.title: Classical and quantized tensionless strings

evidence.text: How can a geometric exactly tensionless string theory be obtained from the tensile string, and what restrictions arise if its classical spacetime conformal symmetry must survive light-cone operator quantization?

sources.title: Dynamical string tension theories with target space scale invariance SSB and restoration

evidence.text: Can world-volume dynamics generate the dimensional tension normally prescribed in a bosonic string or brane action?

sources.title: From Type II string theory toward BSM/dark sector physics

evidence.text: Which gauge representations, axions and massive gauge bosons can supply BSM/dark sectors in controlled string compactifications, and how reliably can their four-dimensional effective interactions be derived? This is a review of explicitly accessible constructions.

sources.title: Matrix models and 2D string theory

evidence.text: How does solvable two-dimensional string theory realize open/closed string duality, and how do matrix eigenvalues and their collective dynamics describe unstable D-particles, tachyon condensation and closed strings?

sources.title: Timelike T duality, de Sitter space, large N gauge theories and topological field theory

evidence.text: What are the timelike T-duals of Type II string theories, and can their E-branes and supersymmetric de Sitter backgrounds motivate large-N Euclidean gauge/string dualities and topological twists?

sources.title: Spin-2 fields and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Does a string spectrum containing massive spin-2 states establish a universal cutoff for an isolated neutral tensor?

sources.title: String dualities and wedge singularities

evidence.text: Can a tentative worldsheet description of type IIA strings on S¹∨S¹, supplemented by strong-coupling physics, reproduce a weakly coupled type 0A frame, including its tachyon and doubled RR charges?

sources.title: Exceptional groups from open strings

evidence.text: Can exceptional gauge vectors receive an open-string description with manifest endpoint charges and natural multiplication, resolving shortcomings of descriptions based solely on two-ended strings following nontrivial paths?

sources.title: dS Spaces and Brane Worlds in Exotic String Theories

evidence.text: Can an exotic string background that admits de Sitter space and perturbative closed-string ghosts nevertheless support a unitary, ghost-free D-brane gauge theory containing a (3,1) subspace?

sources.title: Hamiltonian BRST quantization of the conformal string

evidence.text: Does the bosonic tensionless string admit a Hamiltonian BRST quantization preserving manifest spacetime conformal symmetry, and what dimension is required by BRST nilpotency together with consistent Jacobi identities?

sources.title: Surprises in open string perturbation theory

evidence.text: Review how world-sheet boundaries change perturbative string consistency, anomaly cancellation, tensor-moduli singularities and boundary-state symmetry.

sources.title: A Large N reduced model as superstring

evidence.text: Can a large-N reduced model of ten-dimensional super Yang–Mills provide a constructive, nonperturbative definition of type IIB superstring theory, with spacetime and string interactions emerging from matrices?

sources.title: The art of branching: Cobordism junctions of 10d string theories

evidence.text: Can worldsheet RG interpolations explicitly realize several ten-dimensional string theories meeting at a nine-dimensional junction, as motivated by the Cobordism Conjecture, and accommodate consistent flows of chiral fields between branches?

sources.title: Note on shape moduli stabilization, string gas cosmology and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: How does shearing an equal-radius internal torus away from a square affect the masses of the retained momentum–winding strings?

sources.title: Combinatorics of boundaries in string theory

evidence.text: Can holes in the string world-sheet represent effects of order exp[−O(1/gst)], and what boundary combinatorics permits a consistent treatment of fully Dirichlet boundaries and their divergences?
